semiconductor_relevance: Low — the European Commission is a governmental body and does not directly supply semiconductor products or services.
summary: The European Commission facilitates the participation of approximately 50 leading European semiconductor companies in SEMICON Japan through the EU Pavilion. This initiative aims to enhance collaboration between European and Japanese companies in the semiconductor sector, particularly in green and digital technologies.

regional_presence.Japan: The European Commission is organizing an EU Pavilion at SEMICON Japan to promote European semiconductor companies.
